body.text: LIVE CROSS-FABRIC REVIEW for r2c-model-usage-finance-closure. Preserve the canonical chain physical/model attempt -> UsageOccurrence -> EconomicMeasure -> CostAllocation -> WorkOccurrence/result/proof. Partial or absent token/resource dimensions are UNKNOWN, never zero. A logical work item may have multiple physical retries and each attempt may incur usage; retain attempt identity and prevent both omission and double-counting. Cached/shared realization allocation must be explicit and versioned; avoided work is not automatically cash savings. Pricing is bitemporal/evidenced (effective_at vs observed_at); estimated economics remain distinct from later billed FinancialEvent/reconciliation. Local CPU/GPU/VRAM/wall-time belong in UsageOccurrence even when cash price is unknown. Do not fabricate historical token backfill: instrument future carrier adapters and reconcile only fields actually present in current receipts. Require a real current proof traversal: work -> realization -> usage -> economics -> evidence, preferably including current food/housing work and both Codex/Claude where evidence exists.

subject: Model usage to finance closure: retries, unknowns, pricing reconciliation
